name: wisp-plugins
description: Wisp Plugins marketplace for AGY and Claude Code, published by Orin DX

plugins.name: mason
plugins.description: Build, audit, and behaviorally evaluate plugins; design shared schemas and scaffold conformant agents. Skills: scaffold-plugin, audit-plugin, design-schema, scaffold-subagent, evaluate.

plugins.name: ranger
plugins.description: Bug hunting for Rust, TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, and Go. Confirms reachable defects, searches semantic siblings, and routes structural families for architectural correction.

plugins.name: sentinel
plugins.description: Cross-cutting verification gate. Confirms that any stage artifact meets its criteria before the next stage begins. One skill, one recon-verify-judge pipeline, reused unchanged against any artifact type.

plugins.name: weaver
plugins.description: Need definition plugin. Captures and structures requirements before implementation begins. Integrates with GitHub Issues by default; extensible to Linear, Jira, or any issue tracker that produces the requirement@1 schema. Skills: capture-need, clarify-requirement, prioritize-backlog, connect-requirement, audit-backlog.

plugins.name: vanguard
plugins.description: Research plugin. Investigates questions and requirements to build a documented evidence base before committing to a solution direction. Produces research-report@1 for consumption by scribe (spec).

plugins.name: scribe
plugins.description: Specification plugin. Turns requirements and research reports into unambiguous, testable specs. Checks specs against a persisted whole-system architecture model. Detects spec drift against actual code. Skills: draft-spec, verify-spec, spec-drift, audit-spec, audit-architecture, gate-spec, correct-spec, architect.

plugins.name: muse
plugins.description: Component specification plugin. Turns UI/design intent into unambiguous, testable component specs — props, variants, per-state behavior, and accessibility criteria as testable propositions, gated before planning. Audits the spec, not the implementation — see ranger's accessibility hazard taxonomy for code-level scanning.

plugins.name: navigator
plugins.description: Planning plugin. Decomposes specs into sequenced, bite-sized implementation plans with an implementation approach, exact code as a baseline, and the tests proving each criterion — no write-test-first mandate. Tasks are sized to compilation boundaries, not a clock-time estimate. No TBDs. A developer with zero domain context can execute the plan mechanically.

plugins.name: smith
plugins.description: Implementation plugin. Executes tested plan batches, verifies risk at real boundaries, searches semantic defect siblings, and escalates shared model or architecture gaps.

plugins.name: courier
plugins.description: Shipping plugin. Shepherds completed code through commit, PR creation, review response, and changeset documentation. Skills: commit, pr, changeset, receive-feedback, post-review, release.
